quote: The open-air is the real objective of Scouting and the key to its success.
author: Lord Baden-Powell

quote: Try and leave this world a little better than you found it.
author: Lord Baden-Powell

quote: In every walk with nature one receives far more than he seeks.
author: John Muir

quote: Of all the paths you take in life, make sure a few of them are dirt.
author: John Muir

quote: Look wide, and even when you think you are looking wide - look wider still.
author: Lord Baden-Powell

quote: The far away country, the wild life, the trek, the lodge in the wilderness, the campfire, the pack-train, the night-talks... these are the things that make a man.
author: Theodore Roosevelt

quote: A Scout is never taken by surprise; he knows exactly what to do when anything unexpected happens.
author: Lord Baden-Powell

quote: Leave it as it is. You cannot improve on it. The ages have been at work on it, and man can only mar it.
author: Theodore Roosevelt

quote: The spirit is there in every boy; it has only to be discovered and brought to light.
author: Lord Baden-Powell

quote: Climb the mountains and get their good tidings. Nature's peace will flow into you as sunshine flows into trees.
author: John Muir
